name: dbVar (NCBI database of genomic structural variation)

version.value: FTP root lists ISCA/, archive/, clingen/, data/, sandbox/; data/ last modified 2021-01-21

scope: Archive of SV submissions with studies, variant calls and clinical assertions.

quantitative.summary: Calls with supporting evidence; clinical significance where submitted.

licence.name: NCBI data usage policy: NCBI places no restrictions on the use or distribution of the data in its databases; original submitters may claim rights; acknowledgement of NLM is requested (NCBI Policies and Disclaimers page). dbVar-specific terms were not separately retrieved.
licence.redistribution: No NCBI restriction; third-party submitter rights may apply

update_frequency: The FTP data directory shows 2021 as its last modification; currency not established.
coverage_limitations: Directory dates suggest the FTP may lag the web service

reuse_decision.rationale: Catalogued only: ClinGen, gnomAD-SV and DGV cover the near-term needs; inspect dbVar contents and currency before any download.

evidence_profile.biological_context: Archive of SV and CNV calls submitted by studies of differing design, each with the submitting study's method, samples and assertion. Calls are intervals with breakpoint uncertainty.
evidence_profile.evidence_strength: An archive, not a curated truth set: every submission keeps its own method and quality, calls on the same samples can appear in more than one study, and clinical assertions are submitter judgements.
evidence_profile.mechanistic_confidence: Low. Records give interval, type and, where submitted, an assertion; gene content, breakpoints and regulatory effects must be annotated separately.
evidence_profile.phenotype_implication: Clinical assertions, where submitted, link a call to a condition; population studies link none.
evidence_profile.absence_means: Absence of an overlapping call reflects what submitted studies could detect and report, not rarity or safety.

overlaps_with_sources.note: studies shown in DGV are archived either in dbVar (accessions nsv, nssv) or in DGVa (esv, essv); count each study once
